mapper.sql: FROM consultation_request c JOIN user_account patient ON patient.id=c.patient_id AND patient.is_deleted=0 AND patient.account_status=1 LEFT JOIN consultation_doctor d ON d.user_id=c.doctor_user_id WHERE c.doctor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','REPORT_READY','CLOSED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_account viewer WHERE viewer.id=#{user} AND viewer.is_deleted=0 AND viewer.account_status=1) AND (c.patient_id=#{user} OR (c.doctor_user_id=#{user} AND d.status='APPROVED'))

FROM consultation_message m JOIN consultation_request c ON c.id=m.consultation_id JOIN user_account patient ON patient.id=c.patient_id AND patient.is_deleted=0 AND patient.account_status=1 LEFT JOIN consultation_doctor d ON d.user_id=c.doctor_user_id LEFT JOIN consultation_message_read r ON r.user_id=#{user} AND r.consultation_id=c.id WHERE c.doctor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','REPORT_READY','CLOSED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_account viewer WHERE viewer.id=#{user} AND viewer.is_deleted=0 AND viewer.account_status=1) AND (c.patient_id=#{user} OR (c.doctor_user_id=#{user} AND d.status='APPROVED')) AND m.sender_id<>#{user} AND m.sender_id IN (c.patient_id,c.doctor_user_id) AND m.id>COALESCE(r.through_id,0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.consultation_id=c.id)

SELECT c.id consultation_id,c.title, CASE WHEN c.patient_id=#{user} THEN COALESCE(d.real_name,'接诊医生') WHEN c.anonymous=1 THEN '匿名糖友' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT p.nickname FROM user_profile p WHERE p.user_id=c.patient_id AND p.is_deleted=0),'患者') END peer_name, CASE WHEN c.patient_id=#{user} THEN 'DOCTOR' ELSE 'PATIENT' END peer_role, (SELECT m.content FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.consultation_id=c.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) last_content, (SELECT MAX(m.id) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.consultation_id=c.id) last_message_id, (SELECT m.created_at FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.consultation_id=c.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) last_message_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.consultation_id=c.id AND m.sender_id<>#{user} AND m.sender_id IN (c.patient_id,c.doctor_user_id) AND m.id>COALESCE((SELECT r.through_id FROM consultation_message_read r WHERE r.user_id=#{user} AND r.consultation_id=c.id),0)) unread_count
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.consultation_id=c.id) ORDER BY last_message_id DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AND c.id=#{id} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.consultation_id=c.id AND m.id=#{through} AND m.sender_id<>#{user} AND m.sender_id IN (c.patient_id,c.doctor_user_id))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultation_message_read(user_id,consultation_id,through_id) VALUES(#{user},#{id},#{through}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE through_id=GREATEST(through_id,VALUES(through_id)),read_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
